data.exact_reserve_text: The underwriting loss of GBP 151,717k, analysed below, comprises adverse movements on all underwriting years. Loss experience on all year of account has been significantly worse than anticipated and reserves have been strengthened to reflect experience.

prior_year_events.event_name: Italian Public Hospitals Medical Malpractice (2007 underwriting year)
prior_year_events.impact_description: Uncertainty over Italian Public Hospitals Medical Malpractice reserves led to a reinsurance-to-close (RITC) transaction; liabilities for the 2007 underwriting year were strengthened by GBP 5,833k prior to the external RITC transaction being concluded.
The 2013 underwriting year closed during the financial year and the final amounts settled by members was GBP 41,292k (cash settled).

named_events.loss_description: Uncertainty over reserves resulted in a reinsurance-to-close transaction and strengthening of liabilities relating to the 2007 underwriting year.

data.standardized_narrative: During 2016 the syndicate experienced adverse development on prior underwriting years and reserves were strengthened. Management states that loss experience across all underwriting years was significantly worse than anticipated and that claims liabilities have been increased to reflect that experience. The 2007 underwriting year in particular was affected by Italian Public Hospitals medical malpractice uncertainty and was closed by an RITC transaction, with liabilities strengthened by GBP 5.833m. No single quantified gross prior-year movement for the whole portfolio is explicitly provided in a standalone gross movement note in the accounts.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Statement of Financial Position (Liabilities - Claims outstanding) 2015 comparative column. No explicit single-line 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross figure was located in the notes; a gross claims development table (triangle) is present but extraction of per-cell values from the scanned images is ambiguous and the 2007 RITC transaction may distort older columns. Therefore a consolidated gross prior-year development figure has NOT been provided (null). Narrative explicitly states reserves were strengthened and cites a GBP 5,833k strengthening for the 2007 underwriting year (RITC). Premium mix taken from the segmental analysis note. Claims development triangle exists (gross, in GBP 000) but detailed cell extraction is uncertain from images; users requiring triangle-level analysis should refer to page 36 of the report.
